subject: SparkPlug credit routing and ops for SI-led marketplace POC
messages:
From: Evan Park <evan.park@sparkplug.cloud>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Sean Riley <sean.riley@acme.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Marketplace trial credits for Acme POC (SI-led)

Hi David,

Thanks for taking the call earlier. As discussed, SparkPlug will be delivering the SI services for Acme's pilot, and they asked if Redwood can provide $15k in promotional credits scoped to the marketplace SKU for a 90-day POC.

Quick summary:
- External customer: Acme (contact: Sean Riley)
- Partner: SparkPlug Cloud (SI)
- Requested credit amount: $15,000 (marketplace tokens only)
- Duration: 90 days from activation
- Goal: run a 3-week ramp, then expand to a 3-month evaluation with specific milestone checks (latency < 250ms p95, token spend < $5k/week first month)

Is there a preferred ops flow for routing partner-funded credits? We can sign a simple MOU/escrow instruction if needed. Happy to share draft agreement.

Thanks,
Evan
Partner Success | SparkPlug Cloud

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
To: Evan Park <evan.park@sparkplug.cloud>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Marketplace trial credits for Acme POC (SI-led)

Evan — thanks, this is workable in principle. Looping Vanessa (partner ops) and Marissa (finance) to scope the gating and activate the credits. Connor I’m copying for the entitlement and routing configuration (marketplace-only SKU).

Operational asks from our side:
- We need the partner payment instrument (billing contact) and an escrow instruction or PO referencing Redwood deal SP-2026-091.
- The credit should be constrained to the marketplace SKU and tagged to Acme’s account id; we’ll enforce the 90-day TTL and weekly spend alerts.
- Please confirm the milestone dates so we can set automated evaluation alerts (we’ll tie to the eval webhook).

Vanessa — can you confirm the partner-escrow onboarding checklist and whether we need a formal MSA addendum? Marissa — quick assessment on revenue recognition and whether this should be processed as a contra-revenue credit or as a promotional allowance?

If everyone agrees, I’ll prepare a short activation playbook and we can sign the attached one-page credit agreement.

—David
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 13:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Marketplace trial credits for Acme POC (SI-led)

Team — thanks. Operational notes and next steps:
1) Escrow & paperwork: Evan, thanks for offering the MOU — please send the signed one-page trial-credit-agreement. We require the partner to: provide a PO/escrow instruction referencing SP-2026-091 OR sign the attached one-page. Attachments: trial-credit-agreement-signed.pdf (placeholder for signed doc).
2) Activation method: We will create a marketplace entitlement tied to Acme’s customer_id (please provide) and set a SKU-level cap of $15,000; TTL: 90 days.
3) Controls & alerts: weekly spend alert to Acme and cc: SparkPlug + Redwood ops once spend > $3k/week; auto-throttle at $6k/week to avoid runaway.
4) Compliance: Because funds are partner-provided, finance needs to mark this as promotional allowance; Marissa please confirm accounting treatment and whether we need an intercompany remit flow.

Timeline request: provide signed agreement and Acme customer_id by EOD Monday (9/6) and we’ll aim to activate within 48 hours of receipt.

—Vanessa
Partner Operations | Redwood Inference
Attachments: trial-credit-agreement-template.docx (referenced)

From: Evan Park <evan.park@sparkplug.cloud>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Sean Riley <sean.riley@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 6 Sep 2026 08:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Marketplace trial credits for Acme POC (SI-led)

Thanks Vanessa — attaching the signed one-page (trial-credit-agreement-signed.pdf) and Acme customer id: acme-99843. We’ll also issue PO #SP-ACME-4557 to SparkPlug’s accounting referencing SP-2026-091.

Notes from Acme (Sean): they want the weekly alert set up to go to their platform team slack channel and to have a hard throttle at $7k/week (they prefer slightly higher ceiling). If Redwood can accept $7k/week throttle, we’re good.

Evan

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Evan Park <evan.park@sparkplug.cloud>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.com>, Sean Riley <sean.riley@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 6 Sep 2026 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Marketplace trial credits for Acme POC (SI-led)

Evan / Sean — received signed agreement and PO ref. Finance confirms accounting treatment: process as promotional allowance (contra-revenue) tied to partner-funded credits. We need SparkPlug to remit to Redwood bookkeeping via the PO flow within 30 days of activation; please use invoice code SP-2026-091-TRIAL.

Operationally we have activated the entitlement in staging and will flip to prod after confirming the PO/escrow is in place. Connor will post the activation ticket with the exact entitlement id and the activation timestamp once live.

Connor — please apply weekly alerts to: slack:#acme-platform (per Sean) and emails to evan.park@sparkplug.cloud, sean.riley@acme.com, and partner-ops@redwood.com. Throttle set to $7,000/week (customer requested) with an automatic pause if 3 consecutive days exceed $3k/day.

Evan — please confirm when your finance team has uploaded the PO; we’ll schedule activation within 48 hours afterwards.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Finance Ops | Redwood Inference
Attachments: activation-instructions.txt
